newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. spot millfeed prices remained mostly steady Friday, capping a week of featureless activity, dealers said.
But several dealers said flour mills are expected to take downtimes during the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday week.
Some mills will be shut down for Thanksgiving Nov 28.
"Our flour mills will be down from Thanksgiving to Monday afternoon," a dealer said, referring to the Minneapolis market.
"We have the holiday down, tied in with (mill) fumigation and tied in with repairs, therefore there will not be much feed," he added. "Of course, the prices are not that spiffy."
The abbreviated week may spur some demand for spot loads. "We are getting more conversation. Everybody has not decided to buy yet but people are looking," another dealer said.
